# Microsoft Agent 365 Customer Pitch Deck (Short) — Flashcards

**GENERATED FILE.**

**1. What challenge does the speaker say enterprises face as agents proliferate?**

**Managing agents confidently and securely at scale.** -- The challenge shifts from building agents to governing them. [SRC: Slide 3 speaker notes]

**2. What does the Discovery capability call out in the recap slide?**

**Detect popular agents to control Shadow AI.** [SRC: Slide 11]

**3. What is the stated purpose of integration management?**

**Control what agents can access and do.** [SRC: Slide 11]

**4. Name two Microsoft security/governance products explicitly cited as extending protections to agents.**

**Examples include Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Entra, Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Purview, and Microsoft 365 Admin Center.** [SRC: Slide 10 speaker notes]

**5. What short link is shown for the Agent 365 ecosystem showcase?**

**aka.ms/AgentShowcase** [SRC: Slide 15]

**6. What admin URL is given as the self-serve starting point?**

**admin.microsoft.com** [SRC: Slide 17]

**7. What eligibility threshold is listed for no-additional-cost FastTrack guidance?**

**Eligible plans with 150+ seats.** [SRC: Slide 17]

**8. Who are Agent Builders focused on, per the role model?**

**Innovation and capabilities — what the agent can do.** [SRC: Slide 12]

**9. Who are Agent Users focused on, per the role model?**

**Productivity and outcomes — what the agent does for them.** [SRC: Slide 12]

**10. Who are Agent Operators focused on, per the role model?**

**Oversight and control — what the agent should do.** [SRC: Slide 12]

**11. What licensing note appears in the deck about cloud-subscription-included features?**

**Agent 365 license is not required for features included with Microsoft Cloud Subscription; any Microsoft commercial subscription qualifies, including Azure.** [SRC: Slide 18 speaker notes]

**12. What launch/help channels are highlighted to start deployment?**

**Self-serve resources in Microsoft 365 admin center, plus FastTrack or Microsoft partners.** [SRC: Slide 17]
